coverage.fullFourSourceCoverage: Prior independent full four-source review inherited only by exact SHA-256 for three unchanged sources; changed Host fully read and reviewed with its sole removed block and acknowledged-delete path. All four current sources additionally read in this review.

freshExecution.relocation: Exact copied source/tests/runner; exclusively owned fixtures in this review directory; actual domain, corrected store, serializer and filesystem; managed Unity/game/collection/GUI doubles; counting or throwing outbound fakes only.

verifiedDeleteSemantics: Non-uncertain beforePrepare failure: exact deep draft including ID/time, review, money flags/values and unfinished string fields retained; saved record and durable JSON bytes unchanged; pending null, local IOException error and no retry, not success.
Close/reopen preserves refused draft; subsequent edits/save succeed; later normal delete uses a new operation ID.
Receipt-capacity refusal preserves draft, records, revision and durable bytes across close/reopen; synthetic valid 10000-receipt fixture consumed by actual corrected store.
Unavailable-store guard preserves draft and cached records across reopen; test explicitly uses reflection to dispose/drop store and a throwing factory, not a natural store-loss transition.

Uncertain afterPrepare deletion retains exact request and draft; wrong-card retry cannot clear unrelated draft; reopen correct card and Retry acknowledges once, clears deleted draft/row, no ghost or duplicate revision.
Normal acknowledged delete clears only deleted draft; unrelated-card draft remains.
coverage.outbound: Open, 227-card navigation, query display generation, passive OnGUI at both resolutions and close/reopen produce no outbound actions. Invalid providers/unsafe URLs blocked. Only valid explicit Search/Copy/Listing reach counting fake actions; no real network/browser/clipboard used.
